title: Repeated complications of hematological disorders
summary: Hematological disorder with repeated complications resulting in significant interference with ADLs, social functioning, or completing tasks in timely manner due to deficiencies in concentration/persistence/pace.

children.criterion: Documented hematological disorder with repeated complications (despite continuing treatment)
At least two constitutional symptoms (severe fatigue, fever, malaise, weight loss)
Marked limitation in ADLs, social functioning, or completing tasks in timely manner
Marked limitation in activities of daily living
Marked limitation in completing tasks in timely manner due to concentration, persistence, or pace deficiencies
